ruleDefinitions.name: Triple Cross eBPF Rootkit Install Commands
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects default install commands of the Triple Cross eBPF rootkit based on the "deployer.sh" script

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/sudo$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tc\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ enp0s3\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ qdisc\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ filter\\ .*")))
